lessons.title: What you actually sell
lessons.body: You are not selling software. Nobody wants another app. What you hand people is a gift and an hour of their life back. The gift: their first real document signed on us, no card, no account for the person signing. The time saved: drop a PDF, watch it mark the signature, date, and initial fields it finds, usually in about three seconds, then send. What used to be print, sign, scan, resend becomes one link. That is the whole pitch, and it lands because it is true. Here is the rule that makes you good at this: you cannot sell a feeling you have never felt. Before you tell one person about CyberSygn, run it on your own real contract. A lease, a client agreement, a waiver, whatever is sitting in your inbox right now. Feel the three seconds. Watch the fields appear. Get the tamper-evident certificate at the end. Once you have done it once, you stop pitching and start describing, and describing is what converts.
lessons.action: Upload one real contract you actually need signed and run it through CyberSygn start to finish today, before you share anything.

On top of per-sale bounties there are milestone bonuses when you hit sale counts and monthly sprint bonuses for volume inside a window. You will always see exactly what each sale pays you before you make it. One habit protects all of it: the disclosure line. Any time you post, caption, comment, or share a story in public, add a short and clear note like "(affiliate, I earn a commission)." Private one to one messages do not need it, but stay honest anyway. That one line keeps you FTC-clean and, oddly, people trust the recommendation more when you are open about it.

lessons.title: Your first share today
lessons.body: The single strongest predictor of whether you earn anything is whether you share in your first days. Not your follower count, not your pitch polish, just whether you actually send something before you close this tab. So keep it tiny and do it now. Pick one warm person. Not a broadcast, not your whole list, one human who signs documents and would thank you for this. A realtor friend, a freelancer, a small business owner, your landlord, anyone who has ever emailed you a PDF to sign. Then use one script, no rewriting: "Hey, I found a tool that signs documents in like three seconds and your signer needs no account. First one is free, no card. Want my link? {{LINK}}" Send it. That is the entire task. Do not build a launch, do not wait for the weekend, do not draft five versions. One person, one message, one link, sent. Momentum in the first sitting is what separates ambassadors who earn from ambassadors who forget they signed up.
